name: Marlon Lim Cinense
specialty: Colored Realism & Hyper-Realism, Black & Grey Realism, American Traditional, Neo-Traditional, Oriental
bio: Marlon Lim Cinense is the Founder and Head Artist of Palawan Tattoo Studio and an internationally recognized tattoo artist known for his technical excellence and artistic versatility. Specializing in realism and custom tattooing, he creates high-quality pieces that combine precision, creativity, and lasting impact. With years of experience competing and tattooing both in the Philippines and internationally, Marlon has established himself as one of Puerto Princesa's most respected and sought-after tattoo artists.

name: Arlo Zapanta
specialty: Small Piece Colored Tattoos, Fine Line, Thin Line, Minimalist Tattoos
bio: As the Co-Founder and Senior Artist of Palawan Tattoo Studio, Arlo Zapanta is known for his precision, creativity, and attention to detail. He specializes in small-piece colored tattoos, fine line, thin line, and minimalist designs, creating clean, elegant, and timeless tattoos tailored to every client. His dedication to quality and artistry continues to help shape the studio's reputation for professional and exceptional tattoo work.

name: Jemuel Ferrer
specialty: Small Piece Tattoos, Fine Line, Tribal, Polynesian
bio: Jemuel Ferrer is a highly skilled Senior Tattoo Artist known for his precision, creativity, and attention to detail. He specializes in geometric, dotwork, stippling, darkwork, fine line, thin line, tribal, Polynesian, and traditional Filipino pattern tattoos, blending cultural artistry with modern tattoo techniques. His expertise in intricate and minimalist designs, combined with his precise technique and artistic sensibility, has made him a sought-after artist for clients looking for clean, meaningful, and timeless tattoos.

name: Bryan Cinense
specialty: Fine Line, Thin Line, Black & Grey, Small Piece, Minimalist
bio: Bryan Cinense is one of Palawan's finest fine line and thin line tattoo artists, recognized for his precision, consistency, and exceptionally clean tattoo work. He has mastered the art of creating elegant minimalist designs with crisp, delicate lines, making him a favorite among both locals and travelers seeking meaningful souvenir tattoos from Palawan. He is also highly skilled in black & grey tattooing, producing timeless pieces with outstanding attention to detail.

name: Duke
specialty: Black & Grey, Grey Wash, Opaque, Colored Realism, Blackwork
bio: Duke is a highly respected tattoo artist known for his mastery of Black & Grey, Grey Wash, Opaque, Colored Realism, and Blackwork tattooing. Renowned for creating striking horror, portrait, cinematic, and themed compositions, he combines technical precision with strong artistic storytelling to produce bold and visually impactful tattoos. An active competitor in tattoo conventions across the Philippines, Duke has consistently earned recognition through multiple award-winning performances, making him one of Palawan Tattoo Studio's most accomplished competition artists.

name: Hades Osiris
specialty: Black & Grey Realism, Hyper-Realism, Colored Realism, Portrait, Large Scale
bio: Hades Osiris is one of Palawan's fastest-rising and most accomplished tattoo artists, recognized for his exceptional talent in Black & Grey, Realism, Hyper-Realism, and Colored Realism tattooing. His remarkable technical skill, creativity, and dedication to the craft have made him one of the studio's most decorated artists. As an active competitor in tattoo conventions across the Philippines, Hades has consistently earned multiple awards, showcasing his passion, consistency, and commitment to excellence. His impressive achievements and outstanding artistry have established him as one of the most respected tattoo artists in Palawan.

name: Alyssa Grace Cinense
role: Resident Body Piercer & Permanent Makeup Artist
specialty: Professional Body Piercing, Permanent Makeup, DOH-Certified Body Piercing, Extreme Body Piercing
bio: Alyssa Grace Cinense is the Resident Body Piercer and Permanent Makeup Artist of Palawan Tattoo Studio. Trained by experienced professionals in the Philippines and abroad, she is recognized for her precision, professionalism, and commitment to safety. As a DOH-certified Body Piercer, she has completed various advanced trainings and continues to uphold the highest standards in body piercing and permanent makeup. Known as one of the most trusted body piercers in Palawan, Alyssa combines technical expertise with exceptional client care to deliver safe, comfortable, and high-quality results.
